note: 台股 升降單位 (regular board), the one copy: service/market/semantics/twse_price_policy.py reads it for the paper desk's price check and serves it to the renderer with the paper funds (order tickets step prices on it). Each table is [[below, tick], ...] in price order, the last row's `below` null (every price from there up). `tick_table_of_kind` maps each instrument kind of the security master (service/market/reference/security_master_service.py instrument_kind) to its table: ETF, ETN and REIT (受益證券) use the ETF table. 漲停／跌停 are never derived from 昨收: only the official limits the provider publishes are used.
